# AutoPend

> AutoPend is run by Kartikey Gupta, a full-stack developer with 7+ years of experience, serving businesses across India remotely. It builds and manages the systems growing businesses run on. Free, no-obligation business review call before any quote.

## Services

- Custom website development, with AI integration and ongoing management.
- WhatsApp automation for orders, replies and follow-ups.
- AI voice agent for calling leads and taking follow-ups.
- ERP / CRM / Inventory management software for MSMEs — includes an AI layer that summarises business activity daily and monthly, with full context of everything shared with it.

## Real client work

- [Liv'Oh](https://livoh.in) — home decor e-commerce (D2C).
- [Sunpress Organics](https://sunpressorganic.com) — cold-pressed mustard oil brand storefront (D2C).
- [SunpressERP](https://sunpresserp.onrender.com/) — internal manufacturing ERP for Sunpress (inventory, costing, production tracking).
- [Lex & Ledger](https://lexandledger.in) — legal & financial services marketplace, with an AI support agent that knows every client and every service offered.
